title: The prayer of Ayyub
hook: The prayer of a patient man

phrases.text: Pain, loss and hardship… and still, his heart stayed with Allah.
Prophet Ayyub, peace be upon him, was tested with severe hardship and suffering.
Through it all, he kept turning back to his Lord.
He called out to Allah with gentle words.
Allah told him to strike the ground with his foot, and a cool spring came out, to wash in and to drink.
Allah removed his hardship, and gave back his family, and as many more with them.
Allah said of him: We found him patient. An excellent servant.
Save this for the day you need it.

caption:
“Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.” 🤲
The prayer of Prophet Ayyub (peace be upon him).
